$comment: YouTube Data API quota for automatic posting (D375; PT2 D408). Two models. 'upload-bucket' (the default since PT2): videos.insert has its own daily bucket (uploadBucketPerDay calls a day, not taken from quotaUnitsPerDay); each upload still costs thumbnailUnits from the unit quota. Uploads a day that fit = min(uploadBucketPerDay, floor((quotaUnitsPerDay - readReserveUnits) / thumbnailUnits)), and never more than 24 (the 60-minute gap). 'unit-sum' (the old D375 model, the fallback): each upload costs insertUnits + thumbnailUnits from the unit quota: floor((10000 - 100) / 1650) = 6. When YouTube answers an upload with quotaExceeded while the bucket model is in use, the app counts the 'unit-sum' way for the rest of that Pacific day and fallbackDays more, says so in plain words (task bar and Settings), and tries the bucket model again after (state in <data dir>/posting/quota-model.json). quotaUnitsPerDay is the project's daily quota in Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services > YouTube Data API v3 > Quotas); the user's own value lives in <data dir>/posting/schedule.json. Reads: channels.list, playlistItems.list and videos.list cost 1 unit each. Read by services/posting/quota-budget.mjs; never hardcoded.
source: quotaUnitsPerDay 10000 (default allocation), thumbnailUnits 50, read calls 1 unit, and videos.insert in its own bucket of 100 calls a day: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/determine_quota_cost (fetched 2026-11-13; the bucket is UNVERIFIED for this project until a day with more than 6 uploads goes through). model upload-bucket as the default with the quotaExceeded fallback: user 2026-11-21 ('youtube permits upto 100 uploads a day'; plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-posting-text-schedule-growth.md PT2). insertUnits 1600 (fallback model only): docs/plan/2026-11-03-p16b-youtube-private-upload-plan.md. readReserveUnits 100, fallbackDays 1: agent, not a user instruction.
